import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 6000;
    static final long INF = (long) 1e18;
    static int n, s, t;
    static List<List<Edge>> G;
    static long[] dist;
    static int[] prevv, preve;
    static boolean[] inq;

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev;
        long cap, cost;
        Edge(int to, long cap, long cost, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static void init(int _n, int _s, int _t) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= _n; i++) {
            G.get(i).clear();
        }
        n = _n;
        s = _s;
        t = _t;
    }

    static void addEdge(int from, int to, long cap, long cost) {
        G.get(from).add(new Edge(to, cap, cost, G.get(to).size()));
        G.get(to).add(new Edge(from, 0, -cost, G.get(from).size() - 1));
    }

    static long minCostFlow(long f) {
        long res = 0;
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0, n, INF);
        while (f > 0) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0, n, INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            inq[s] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int now = q.poll();
                inq[now] = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < G.get(now).size(); i++) {
                    Edge e = G.get(now).get(i);
                    if (e.cap > 0 && dist[now] + e.cost < dist[e.to]) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[now] + e.cost;
                        prevv[e.to] = now;
                        preve[e.to] = i;
                        if (!inq[e.to]) {
                            inq[e.to] = true;
                            q.offer(e.to);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == INF) return -1;

            long d = f;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                d = Math.min(d, G.get(prevv[v]).get(preve[v]).cap);
            }
            f -= d;
            res += d * dist[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge e = G.get(prevv[v]).get(preve[v]);
                e.cap -= d;
                G.get(v).get(e.rev).cap += d;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long N = sc.nextLong();
        long M = sc.nextLong();
        long K = sc.nextLong();
        long C = sc.nextLong();
        long D = sc.nextLong();

        long[] A = new long[58];
        List<Integer>[] H = new ArrayList[57];
        for (int i = 0; i < H.length; i++) {
            H[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= (int)K; i++) {
            long X = sc.nextLong();
            A[(int)X]++;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= (int)M; i++) {
            long X = sc.nextLong();
            long Y = sc.nextLong();
            H[(int)X].add((int)Y);
            H[(int)Y].add((int)X);
        }

        // Initialize graph
        G = new ArrayList<>(MAXN);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            G.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        dist = new long[MAXN];
        prevv = new int[MAXN];
        preve = new int[MAXN];
        inq = new boolean[MAXN];

        init(5103, 0, 5101);
        for (int i = 2; i <= (int)N; i++) {
            addEdge(0, i, A[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
            for (int l = 1; l <= (int)N; l++) {
                addEdge(50 * i + l, 50 * (i + 1) + l, K, 0);
                for (int j : H[l]) {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= (int)K; k++) {
                        addEdge(50 * i + l, 50 * (i + 1) + j, 1, D * (2 * k - 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= 101; i++) {
            addEdge(50 * i + 1, 5101, K, C * i);
        }

        long result = minCostFlow(K);
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
